paper.title_en: Measurement of the differential cross section for inclusive isolated photon production in proton-proton collisions at sqrt(s) = 13.6 TeV
paper.abstract_en: A measurement of the differential cross section for inclusive isolated photon production in proton-proton collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13.6~\mathrm{TeV}$ is presented. The analysis uses data collected by the CMS experiment in 2022, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of $27~\mathrm{fb}^{-1}$. The cross section is measured as a function of the photon transverse momentum and pseudorapidity in a fiducial region. The results are compared with predictions from next-to-leading-order perturbative QCD.
